Every great closer expects objections. They're not a sign the deal is dead — they're a signal the client is still engaged and needs one more nudge. Know these three core objections cold.
This is the most common objection. Here's your playbook:
"I completely understand — production is a real investment."
Walk them through each line item. Show them what's included: 4K crew, $1M insurance, Beige Guarantee, RAW content, editing, revisions. Most clients don't realize how much they're getting.
"You're not just hiring a videographer — you're getting a fully managed production team with a guaranteed backup and professional edits delivered in 2–3 weeks."
"Let me speak to my team and see what I can do."
Then offer up to 20% off — never more without manager approval.
"You get what you pay for — we're like the Gucci of production. You wouldn't go to the Gucci store and haggle on price."
Never discount more than 20% of the pricing calculator output.
